# Logitech G – Advanced Gaming Gear & Peripherals

Logitech G delivers pro-level gaming gear. Find high-performance headsets, keyboards, and mice to elevate your game. Dominate with the best. Shop now!


## Product Catalog

- [Product Catalog](https://www.logitechg.com/catalog.txt): Index of Markdown (.md) mirrors of Logitech G product detail pages, with specs and features structured for AI agents and LLM crawlers.

## Shopping Categories
- [SHOP](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop): The main shopping portal for all Logitech G products.
- [Gaming Mice](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-mice): A selection of high-performance gaming mice designed for various gaming styles.
- [Gaming Mousepads](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-mousepads): Mousepads optimized for gaming precision and comfort.
- [Gaming Keyboards](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-keyboards): Keyboards engineered for gamers, featuring responsive keys and customizable options.
- [Gaming Headsets & Audio](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-headsets-audio): A range of headsets and audio solutions for immersive gaming experiences.
- [Racing Wheels](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/racing-wheels-pedals): Specialized wheels for racing simulation enthusiasts.
- [Microphones](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/microphones): High-quality microphones for streaming and gaming.
- [Simulation](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/simulation-gear): Products designed for simulation gaming, including flight and racing gear.
- [Racing Configurator](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/configurator/sim-racing-configurator): A tool for customizing racing setups.
- [Cameras & Lighting](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-cameras-lighting): Equipment for enhancing streaming and gaming environments.
- [Cloud Gaming](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/cloud-gaming): Solutions and products for cloud-based gaming experiences.
- [Gamepads & Controllers](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gamepads-controllers): Controllers designed for various gaming platforms.
- [Gaming Furniture](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-furniture): Ergonomic furniture designed for gamers.
- [Accessories](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/gaming-gear-accessories): Additional gaming accessories to enhance the gaming experience.
- [Refurbished Products](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/c/certified-refurbished): A selection of refurbished Logitech products at discounted prices.

## Gaming Series
- [FPS - PRO Series](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/fps/pro-gaming-gear): A series of products tailored for first-person shooter gamers.
- [FPS - G Series](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/fps/core-gaming-gear): Gaming gear designed for FPS enthusiasts.
- [Racing](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/racing/pro-g-racing-gear): Products specifically for racing games.
- [Sandbox Survival](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/sandbox/core-gaming-gear): Gear for sandbox survival gaming experiences.
- [Openworld](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/open-world/console-gaming-gear): Equipment for open-world gaming adventures.
- [Simulation - Flight](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/sim/flight-gear): Products focused on flight simulation gaming.
- [Simulation - Space](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/shop/sim/space-gear): Gear designed for space simulation games.

## Technology Features
- [HERO 2](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/hero-2-sensor): Advanced sensor technology for precise tracking in gaming mice.
- [LIGHTSPEED](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/lightspeed): Wireless technology providing ultra-fast response times.
- [PLAYSYNC](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/playsync): Synchronization technology for immersive gaming experiences.
- [LIGHTSYNC](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/lightsync-rgb): RGB lighting technology that reacts to in-game actions.
- [LIGHTFORCE](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/lightforce): Innovative technology for enhanced tactile feedback in gaming.
- [TRUEFORCE](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/trueforce): Advanced force feedback technology for racing wheels.
- [Direct Drive](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/direct-drive): High-performance direct drive technology for racing simulations.
- [Mechanical Switches](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/mechanical-switches): Durable and responsive switches used in gaming keyboards.
- [PRO-G Gaming Audio](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/pro-g-gaming-audio): High-fidelity audio technology for gaming headsets.
- [POWERPLAY 2](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/powerplay-2): A wireless charging system for gaming mice.
- [BLUE VO!CE](https://www.logitechg.com//en-us/discover/technology/blue-voice): Technology for professional-grade voice clarity in streaming.

- [Press](https://news.logitech.com/overview/default.aspx): Press releases and media information.
